assumptions: The latest R-169 v1.4 and R-170 authorities are the active TECT owner boundaries.
The requested sign orientation is G_* minus E and all three tests must use one common regulated parent.
A physical-empty branch requires a normalized state/configuration, a measure or algebra, boundary preparation, and a physical interpretation beyond a one-point zero condition.
A finite preregistration audit may reject evaluation when any required owner field is absent; rejection is not a numerical sign or stability theorem.
Symmetry projection means removing the exact declared orbit tangent before forming a transverse Hessian infimum.
blockers: R-169 v1.4 explicitly states that its corrected scalar owner is not the full Reading-H Hartree functional and supplies no physical-empty comparison.
R-170 keeps the applicable B1 result at F_total[Q] > F_total[G_*] and imports no G_* versus physical-empty sign.
EXP-000790 records a future same-H contract but says a strict comparator must be a separately preregistered constrained or preparation branch; it does not instantiate one.
The P1 zero/disordered reference is a different owner and no full Reading-H-to-P1 functional or ensemble intertwiner is registered.
Consequently the three requested quantities are undefined for the physical-empty interpretation and must not be numerically evaluated.
boundary: R-420 executes the requested preregistration check and records a new E slot, but it remains BLOCKED because the common finite-regulator owner and admitted physical-empty branch are absent. The sign, Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability are all BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED PREREGISTRATION AND INPUT-ADMISSIBILITY AUDIT; no energy difference, stationarity residual, or Hessian was evaluated
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned finite-regulator F_total whose domain contains both G_* and E.
A normalized physical-empty E representative in that same domain, with a local no-condensate or clustering admission criterion.
Common reference, normalization, finite-part counterterms and renormalization conditions.
A physical volume, regulator/cutoff, boundary condition and explicit thermodynamic-then-continuum limit order.
Deterministic finite-parent maps for G_* and E, a full admissible tangent and an exact symmetry orbit tangent.
A transverse projector, regulated Hessian formula, stationarity residual budget and numerical/limit error budgets.
non_claims: No identification of E with zero, the P1 disordered reference, a Gaussian state, or any equilibrium phase.
No physical-vacuum, below-empty-space, Yang-Mills, mass-gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion.
No thermodynamic, continuum, OS/KMS/GNS, Hamiltonian spectral or absolute-energy conclusion.
